title: Invoice PDF download
state: OPEN
labels: enhancement
export async function getInvoice(accountId: string, id: string) { … }

The statements worker already writes each PDF to S3 and records `pdf_key` on the invoice. What is missing is a route that streams it and a button that calls the route. I'll split this into three items.
